limits: Native Windows GPU, macOS and Android device runs were not performed.
Frame generation was not tested for this release.
The Autochess UI first-click packaged cases fail identically on 1.37.0 (separate render thread with synthetic input); whether real player input is affected is not established.
The gz5h frame-rate fix was measured in single player; a two-machine co-op session was not measured.
Path tracing and frame generation remain experimental.
